statement.p: Nathan earned {\$175.14} of interest from a mutual fund, which was 0.63\% of his total investment. How much money did Nathan invest into this mutual fund?
Nathan invested in this mutual fund.

solution.p: This problem can be boiled down to this question: 175.14 is 0.63\% of what? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem. Assume 175.14 is 0.63\% of x, so 0.63 out of 100 corresponds to 175.14 out of x.
We will write and solve the proportion:
Nathan invested {\$27{,}800.00} in this mutual fund.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem. This translation from English to math may help you remember the percentage formula.
The question is: 175.14 is 0.63\% of what? Assume 175.14 is 0.63\% of x. We have:
Nathan invested {\$27{,}800.00} in this mutual fund.
In the sentence 175.14 is 0.63\% of what,

li.p: what is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{base} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{rate}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
Nathan invested {\$27{,}800.00} in this mutual fund.
